summary: DOMVUS Phase 1 tested end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 pytest passing covering auth (login/me/logout, invalid pw 401, brute-force 429), RBAC (owner blocked from all POSTs, 403), tenant isolation (owner sees only own condo/fractions/txns, 403 on cross-condo GET; super_admin sees all 3), CRUD condominiums with cascade delete, fractions/owners CRUD with computed balance, transactions creating charge/payment updating fraction balance (charge 50 + charge 10 − payment 30 = 30; delete charge => 20), dashboard structure/receivable equality with sum of positive fraction balances, dashboard condominium_id filter, owner-scoped dashboard. Frontend: login prefilled works, /dashboard renders totals (3 condos, 18 fractions, 18 owners, 1221€ receivable) with charts, aging, recent payments; navigation to /condominios, /fracoes, /condominos works; add-condominium modal creates and lists new condo (verified TEST_UI_Condo visible then cleaned up). No critical UI or integration issues.

issues: Recharts prints repeated console warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1)' during initial mount — cosmetic only, charts still render correctly after layout settles.
Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby — accessibility warning.

action_items: (Low) Silence Recharts width/height warnings by ensuring ResponsiveContainer parent has explicit min-height on first paint.
(Low) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to all Radix Dialogs to fix a11y warnings.
(Info) Dashboard 'overdue' is currently just equal to 'receivable' (see routes.py line 108). If a true 30-day overdue metric is desired later, split it from receivable.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py: fraction_balance() and list_fractions loop do N+1 async queries per fraction (one full transactions scan per fraction). Fine at seed scale but will not scale — aggregate via a single $group query keyed by fraction_id.
routes.py list_owners does N+1 as well (fractions per owner + fraction_balance per fraction).

auth.py: brute-force lockout uses ISO-string comparison on created_at which works but is fragile if any doc lacks timezone; would be more robust to store real datetimes and use $gt with datetime objects.
server.py: FRONTEND_URL default is http://localhost:3000; ensure it is set in prod env for CORS + reset email links. CORS list is hardcoded, consider comma-separated env list.
routes.py delete_condominium cascades but does not run inside a transaction — partial failures could leave orphans (acceptable at MVP).
models.py TransactionInput.amount has no non-negative validation; negative amounts on charge/payment can invert balances (adjustment is allowed to be signed by design).
